summary: The DestProfileHistory is a user control in ASP.NET that manages the display and interaction with destination profiles within the HSPnet system. It involves the use of session data to filter and present relevant information.
purpose: The main purpose of the DestProfileHistory user control is to interface with destination-related data, allowing users to view and interact with historical data associated with a specific destination profile within the HSPnet application.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Represents the current user's session, used to determine access and filter data.

fields.name: DestID
fields.description: Identifies the destination profile being accessed or viewed.

fields.name: Button1
fields.description: A button control defined for user interaction.

fields.name: Label1
fields.description: A label control for displaying text.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: A grid view for displaying the list of destination profiles.

fields.name: dsDestProfileHistory
fields.description: A data source control used to retrieve destination profile history data.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Interacts with the user control to access destination profile history.

workflows.name: Selecting Destination Profile History
steps: User initiates a request to view destination profile history.
System checks if UserSession is established.
If UserSession is null, selection event is cancelled.
If UserSession is valid, inputs parameters are set using DestID and SessionAgencyID.
Data is retrieved via the ObjectDataSource and displayed on the gridData.

validations: Ensure UserSession is not null before proceeding with data selection.
conditions: Check if UserSession is null to determine if the selection event should be cancelled.
system_behavior: The system will cancel the data selection event if the UserSession object is null.
dependencies: UserSession object is used to determine agency-specific data access and filtering.
exceptions: If UserSession is not established, data retrieval for destination profile history will not occur.
